description: Damped Gauss-Newton on LUT weights. The LUT is linear in its weights for fixed selection, with diagonal Hessian = per-row visit count (exposed via new enable_visit_count_stash in tiny_multi_head_lut). Step = -lr*m/(count_ema+lam), per-tensor RMS-normalized to lr so it is directly comparable to LION/signSGD (lut_lr=2e-4). lam=32 is Levenberg-Marquardt damping (lam=0 == exp441 undamped Newton, which was +0.010 worse). Tests whether the exact count preconditioner beats LION's sign (exp454=1.4969) and Adam's RMS (exp428=1.4983) at LION-tier memory. beta1=0.9 momentum (load-bearing). Non-LUT stay AdamW. Saves checkpoint.
